source_units.text: Write a quest-giver speech for an imaginary adventure game.
Write for players receiving the invented quest.
These invented details are required: The quest asks players to enter the Lantern Orchard and collect three silver seeds from fallen fruit.
The instruction is "do not wake the giant"; the quest giver needs the seeds to relight the village clock.
Include each of these exact strings: "the Lantern Orchard", "three silver seeds", "do not wake the giant".
Make the voice urgent and adventurous.
